<!-- What problem this change solves and why, in your own words. -->

<!-- What behavior/result is expected after this change lands. -->

<!-- Context the code cannot infer: product rules, configs, prior decisions. -->

## Scope and non-goals

<!-- What is included, and what is explicitly excluded. -->

<!-- Files/components touched; who owns review. -->

## Dependencies

<!-- Issues/PRs this depends on or unblocks; external version pins. -->

## Assumptions and open decisions

<!-- Assumptions made, unresolved decisions, escalations needed. -->
